title: Give a reason
instructions: Decide how the two ideas are linked, then choose the word.

parts.prompt: The bus was cancelled ___ the bridge had been closed for repairs.

choice_rationales.A: The closed bridge explains why the bus was cancelled.
choice_rationales.B: Although would suggest that the closed bridge made a bus service more likely.
choice_rationales.C: Unless would mean the bus runs only when the bridge is closed.
choice_rationales.D: So that shows a purpose, and nobody cancelled the bus in order to close the bridge.

parts.correct_explanation: The closed bridge is the reason for the cancelled bus, so because fits.
